summary: The first agent that setup publishes is the Smalltalk Assistant (agent/st/assistant), not the built-in expert; the setup flag that starts it is --assistant.

replay.detail: Ordinary declaration and mission-run replay is unchanged.

schema.detail: No database or claim schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or replication rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Setup publishes agent/st/assistant with the display name Smalltalk Assistant and works in ~/st/agents/st-assistant. The subject agent/st/expert, the setup flag --expert and the workspace ~/st/agents/st-expert are gone, with no alias: the built-in expert landed on main on 2026-10-12 and is in no release, so no released install has them. An install built from main that already published agent/st/expert keeps that declaration as an ordinary agent until its owner stops it; setup does not remove or migrate it.

downtime.detail: No daemon or seat restart is required.

manual.detail: No operator action is needed. On a host that ran setup from main before this change, stop the old seat with st agents stop agent/st/expert if it is running.

recovery.detail: No store migration or recovery procedure changes.
